children: Clearwater Paper entered into a Second Amended and Restated Credit Agreement comprising a $200 million asset-based revolving facility and a $275 million term loan, maturing Sep 18 2031 with initial interest of 8.25%. Proceeds were used to fund the full redemption of $275 million 4.750% Senior Notes due 2028 and to repay and terminate the 2019 ABL facility. The company drew the full term loan and $15 million on the revolver at closing, enhancing liquidity and extending maturities. The Indenture governing the 2028 notes has been satisfied and discharged, and obligations under the ABL were released.
Agreement 1: Clearwater Paper Secures $475 Million Credit Facilities to Refinance 2028 Notes
: Secured revolving credit facility ($200M) and term loan ($275M)
: AgWest Farm Credit, as administrative agent, and other lenders
: Refinance notes, replace ABL, extend maturities and liquidity
Agreement 2: Clearwater Paper to Redeem $275 Million 2028 Notes; Indenture Discharged
: 4.750% Senior Notes due 2028 and related Indenture
: Debt redemption funded by new credit facilities
Agreement 3: Clearwater Paper Terminates 2019 ABL Facility After New Credit Agreement Closing
: JPMorgan Chase Bank, as administrative agent, and lenders
: Replaced by new secured credit agreement
